subject: Commendation for Range Support Coordination
addressees: Sergeant First Class Jordan A. Lee

paragraphs.text: I commend you for outstanding coordination of the Range 14 maintenance support plan from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
Your precise scheduling with Range Control and the garrison safety office protected training readiness and kept subordinate units informed.
My point of contact for this memorandum is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
